title.en: Substation Practices,Earthing and Compensation
3.1 Switching schemes at 765/400/220/132 kV

body.en:
Definition

A substation switching scheme defines how buses, breakers and disconnectors connect circuits and permit isolation, maintenance and fault clearance while meeting a specified reliability requirement.

Classification / scope

  • Single/sectioned bus; double bus with transfer capability; ring bus; breaker-and-a-half; double breaker. Select by availability, fault consequences, cost and maintainability.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Voltage alone does not mandate one scheme.765/400kVcritical nodes may use breaker-and-a-half or double-breaker arrangements; 220/132kVnodes often use double/sectioned buses, with utility-specific alternatives.
  • Breaker-and-a-half uses three breakers for two circuits in a diameter; the shared middle breaker and protection zones require careful coordination—not simply 1.5physical devices on one line.
  • Fault on a bus section must trip its defined protection zone; unaffected sections remain available only if topology, protection and transfer capacity support them.
  • Actual operation uses a reviewed switching order, load-flow limits, interlocks and protection checks. The diagram explains topology, not a universal executable switching instruction.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Switching scheme buses, breakers/disconnectorsથી circuits કેવી રીતે જોડાય/isolate, maintain/fault-clear થાય તે reliability requirement મુજબ નક્કી કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Single/sectioned, double bus, ring, breaker-and-a-half, double breaker—availability, fault consequence, cost/maintenance મુજબ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • માત્ર voltageથી scheme ફરજિયાત નથી.765/400 kV critical nodesમાં breaker-and-a-half/double-breaker; 220/132kVમાં double/sectioned buses હોઈ શકે, utility-specific alternatives સાથે.
  • Breaker-and-a-half diameterમાં બે circuits માટે ત્રણ CB; shared middle CB/protection coordination જરૂરી—એક lineમાં physical 1.5device નહીં.
  • Bus-section faultમાં defined zone trip થાય; unaffected service topology/protection/transfer capacity હોય ત્યારે જ ચાલુ રહે.
  • Actual operation reviewed order, load-flow/interlocks/protection સાથે; diagram universal switching instruction નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Operational monitoring observes electrical state and equipment condition with time and data quality so that abnormalities are detected and authorised actions can be evaluated.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Record bus voltage, frequency, feeder/transformer current, P, Q, PF, load distribution, tap position, breaker state and alarms using correct CT/VTratios and sign conventions.
  • Ashift log includes time, device ID, measured values, quality, alarm, authority, action and result; SOEuses synchronised time to reconstruct sequence rather than assuming display order is cause.
  • Voltage/reactive-power control considers OLTC, capacitor/reactor status and network conditions; an unexplained low voltage is not automatic permission to close a bank.

Worked example / interpretation

  1. For an illustrative balanced 11 kV, 200Aload at PF 0.8lag, S≈3.811 MVA, P≈3.048 MW, Q≈2.286 Mvar. These are computed values, not recorded site readings.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Operational monitoring time/data quality સાથે electrical state/condition જુએ જેથી abnormality શોધી authorised action assess થઈ શકે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Bus V, frequency, I, P, Q, PF, load, tap, CB/alarms correct CT/VT ratio/sign સાથે નોંધો.
  • Shift logમાં time, ID, values, quality, alarm, authority/action/result; SOE synchronised timeથી sequence બનાવે—display orderને cause નમાનો.
  • V/Q controlમાં OLTC, bank/reactor/network જુઓ; low voltageથી automatic bank-close permission નથી.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / અર્થઘટન

  1. Illustrative 11 kV, 200 A, PF 0.8lagમાં S≈3.811 MVA/P≈3.048 MW/Q≈2.286 Mvar; computed છે, site reading નહીં.

title.en: 3.2 Preventive, predictive and proactive maintenance

body.en:
Definition

Maintenance is the organised set of checks, servicing and corrective actions that preserves or restores equipment function and acceptable risk throughout service life.

Classification / scope

  • Preventive(time/operation); predictive(condition forecast); proactive(root-cause removal); corrective(after detected defect/failure).

Detailed explanation and application

  • Preventive: scheduled servicing based on time/operations, for example approved mechanism lubrication; predictive: condition/trend-based forecast, for example rising comparable joint temperature.
  • Proactive: remove a recurrent root cause, such as correcting a poorly designed moisture ingress path rather than repeatedly drying a cabinet.
  • Criticality, failure modes, spares, permit windows and post-maintenance functional checks govern the plan. Acalendar entry alone does not prove the work is safe or successful.
  • Close work orders with defect evidence, parts/test results, settings changes and return-to-service authority; retain baseline for the next comparison.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Maintenance organised checks, service/correctionથી equipment function/acceptable risk જાળવે અથવા પુનઃસ્થાપિત કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Preventive(time/operation), predictive(condition forecast), proactive(root cause), corrective(detected defect/failure).

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Preventive સમય/operations આધારિત service જેમ mechanism lubrication; predictive condition/trend forecast જેમ comparable joint temperature વધવું.
  • Proactive repeated root cause દૂર કરે જેમ cabinet વારંવાર સૂકવવાને બદલે moisture ingress design સુધારવું.
  • Criticality, failure modes, spares, permit window/post-testથી plan બને; calendar entry safe/successful work proof નથી.
  • Work orderમાં defect, parts/results, settings/return authority બંધ કરો; આગળ માટે baseline રાખો.

title.en: 3.3 Earthing: purpose and hazardous potentials

body.en:
Definition

Earthing deliberately connects designated conductive parts or system points to an engineered earth electrode system to manage fault current, potential differences and protective operation.

Classification / scope

  • Protective/system/lightning functions; hazards: step, touch, transferred and floating potential.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Protective earthing bonds exposed conductive parts; system neutral earthing establishes fault/overvoltage behaviour; lightning earth paths must be coordinated with station bonding.
  • Step voltage is the surface potential difference between feet separated by a defined step; touch voltage is the difference between a contacted structure and the standing surface.
  • Transferred potential carries remote/station earth potential via a conductor beyond the local grid; floating metal has no reliable reference and may become energised by faults/induction/capacitance.
  • Low measured earth resistance does not alone establish safe touch/step voltage; fault current split, clearing time, soil layers, surface layer, bonding and accessible points all matter.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Earthing designated conductive parts/system pointsને engineered electrode system સાથે જોડીને fault current, potential differences/protective operation manage કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Functions: protective/system/lightning; hazards: step, touch, transferred/floating.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Protective earthing exposed parts bond કરે; neutral earthing fault/overvoltage behaviour નક્કી કરે; lightning paths station bonding સાથે coordinate થાય.
  • Step voltage defined stepથી અલગ feet વચ્ચે surface potential difference; touch voltage contacted structure/standing surface વચ્ચે difference.
  • Transferred potential conductorથી grid બહાર/અંદર remote potential લાવે; floating metalનું reliable reference ન હોવાથી fault/induction/capacitanceથી energise થઈ શકે.
  • Low earth resistanceથી touch/step safe સાબિત નહીં; current split, clearing time, soil/surface layers, bonding/access પણ જરૂરી.

h.en: Solid/resistance neutral earthing and electrode forms
h.gu: Solid/Resistance Neutral Earthing તથા Electrode Forms

body.en:
Definition

Neutral earthing is the method of connecting the system neutral to earth to control earth-fault behaviour; electrode geometry is the physical arrangement coupling that system to soil.

Classification / scope

  • Neutral: solid/resistance and other study-specific methods; electrodes: grid, rod, pipe, plate, counterpoise.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Solid neutral earthing has no intentional current-limiting impedance; resistance earthing inserts a designed NERto limit earth-fault current and coordinate protection.
  • Grid/mesh, rod, plate, pipe and counterpoise are electrode arrangements, not substitutes for neutral-earthing classification. Counterpoise conductors spread earth contact along a route.
  • NERvoltage, current, time rating, insulation and continuity monitoring follow the network study; an open NERcan silently change fault behaviour.
  • Source 1×1mstudent mesh is a fabrication/model exercise, not an approved substation grid. Real design needs soil resistivity, grid-current split, clearing time, step/touch criteria and qualified review.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For a simplified predominantly resistive neutral path, RNER≈Vphase/Ifault, target, where Vphase=VLL/√3 and other impedances are neglected.
  2. At 11kV and 200Atarget, R≈11000/(√3×200)=31.75 Ω; instantaneous resistor dissipation≈I²R=1.27 MW. A 10sduty implies about 12.7MJbefore thermal/design margins.
  3. This estimate does not select a real NER: network impedance, protection, voltage tolerance and thermal duty must be checked.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Neutral earthing neutral-earth connectionથી earth-fault behaviour control કરે; electrode geometry soil સાથે physical coupling arrangement છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Neutral: solid/resistance/study-specific; electrodes: grid, rod, pipe, plate, counterpoise.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Solid earthingમાં intentional current-limiting impedance નહીં; resistance earthingમાં NER current limit/protection coordination કરે.
  • Grid/mesh, rod, plate, pipe/counterpoise electrode arrangements છે, neutral classes નહીં.Counterpoise route પર earth contact ફેલાવે.
  • NER V, I, time rating, insulation/continuity study મુજબ; open NER fault behaviour ચૂપચાપ બદલી શકે.
  • Source 1×1m mesh student model છે, approved station grid નહીં.Real designમાં soil resistivity, current split, time, step/touch/review જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Simplified resistive neutral pathમાં RNER≈Vphase/Ifault, target; Vphase=VLL/√3, બીજા impedances neglected.
  2. 11 kV/200Aમાં R≈11000/(√3×200)=31.75 Ω; I²R≈1.27 MW; 10sમાં≈12.7MJ, margins પહેલાં.
  3. આ estimateથી real NER select નહીં; network impedance, protection, tolerance/thermal duty તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Ground-potential rise is the voltage of an earthing system relative to remote earth during current injection; earth-resistance measurement is one input to—not a replacement for—the complete safety assessment.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Use a suitable earth-resistance tester and approved test geometry, not an insulation megger. Performing fall-of-potential tests on live interconnected grids needs specialist planning and induced-voltage precautions.
  • Afall-of-potential setup uses current and potential probes; probe spacing, buried services, stray current and parallel earth paths affect the result. Aclamp method has specific closed-loop assumptions.
  • Soil resistivity testing, continuity checking and grid impedance/step-touch assessment answer different questions. Document geometry, soil/weather, instrument and uncertainty rather than writing only one ohm value.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Simplified GPR=IG Rg, using the current actually injected into the grid IG, not automatically the total system earth-fault current.
  2. If total fault current=5kAand grid split=0.4, IG=2 kA. With Rg=0.5 Ω, GPR≈1000 V. This is not the accessible touch voltage and is not a safety approval.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

GPR current injection દરમિયાન earthing systemનું remote earth સામે voltage છે; earth-resistance measurement complete safety assessmentનો માત્ર એક input છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Suitable earth tester/approved geometry લો, insulation megger નહીં.Live interconnected grid test specialist planning/induction precautionsથી.
  • Fall-of-potentialમાં current/potential probes; spacing, services, stray current/parallel paths પરિણામ બદલે.Clamp methodની closed-loop assumptions છે.
  • Soil resistivity, continuity/grid impedance/step-touch જુદા પ્રશ્નો છે.Geometry, soil/weather, instrument/uncertainty લખો, માત્ર ohm નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Simplified GPR=IGRg; IG actual grid injection છે, automatic total earth-fault current નહીં.
  2. Total 5 kA/split 0.4માં IG=2 kA; Rg 0.5Ωથી GPR≈1000 V.તે accessible touch voltage/safety approval નથી.

h.en: Standards, operative regulations and clearance meaning

body.en:
Definition

A clearance is a specified separation for a stated insulation or safe-working purpose; minimum electrical design clearance and safety working clearance are different quantities.

Detailed explanation and application

  • The syllabus cites IS 3043: 2018earthing, IS 5613Part 2Section 1overhead-line design and historical CEA 2010Rule 42.Use each only within scope; an overhead-line document is not a complete substation-grid design.
  • CEA 2010is historical, superseded by the 2023safety framework. The downloaded 2026BESSamendment states commencement 1April 2027; it is not operative on 1November 2026.
  • Outdoor bare/live apparatus safety working clearance, phase-earth/phase-phase insulation clearance and overhead-line clearance must not be interchanged. Apply current statutory schedules, utility rules, altitude and approved isolation plan.
  • No unverified generic clearance table here authorises approach or live work. Verify the operative statutory text and site-specific procedure before any actual work.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Clearance stated insulation/safe-working purposeનું specified separation છે; minimum electrical design/working clearance જુદાં છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Syllabusમાં IS 3043: 2018earthing/IS 5613Part 2Section 1line design/historical CEA 2010Rule 42 છે; scope મુજબ વાપરો.Line standard complete grid design નથી.
  • CEA 2010 historical છે, 2023frameworkથી superseded. Downloaded 2026BESS amendment 1April 2027થી અમલમાં—1November 2026ના રોજ નહીં.
  • Outdoor working clearance, phase-earth/phase-phase insulation/overhead-line clearance interchange નહીં.Current schedules, utility, altitude/isolation plan લાગુ કરો.
  • અહીં generic clearanceથી approach/live-work permission નથી.Actual work પહેલાં operative text/site procedure verify કરો.

title.en: 3.4 Capacitor banks: principle, construction and limits
title.gu: 3.4 Capacitor Banks: Principle, Construction તથા Limits

h.en: Capacitor banks: principle, construction and limits
h.gu: Capacitor Banks: Principle, Construction તથા Limits

body.en:
Definition

A shunt capacitor bank supplies local capacitive reactive power to reduce the upstream reactive demand of an inductive load, within a coordinated voltage, harmonic and switching design.

Classification / scope

  • Fixed/switched; LV/HV; star/delta; plain/detuned arrangements according to harmonic study.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Load reactive demand sets Qbefore; capacitor supplies Qc, so upstream Qafter=Qbefore−Qc while real load Premains approximately unchanged.
  2. Lower upstream Qreduces current for the same Pand voltage, but capacitor/switching losses remain and kWhsaving is not equal to kvarrating.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Fixed/switched stages, LV/HVbanks and star/delta connections are distinct classification axes. Bank units, fuses/protection, switching device, discharge resistors and often reactors form the installation.
  • Staged control avoids overcompensation at light load; harmonic resonance, inrush, unbalance and overvoltage need studies. Capacitors retain charge after isolation.
  • Approved maintenance inspects bulging/leaks, fuses, unbalance, connections, reactors and discharge paths; specified wait time, verified discharge and earthing precede touch.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Shunt capacitor bank local capacitive reactive power આપી inductive loadની upstream reactive demand ઘટાડે; voltage, harmonic/switching design limitsમાં.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Fixed/switched, LV/HV, star/delta, plain/detuned—harmonic study મુજબ.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Loadનું Qbefore, bankનું Qc; Qafter=Qbefore−Qc, real P આશરે સમાન.
  2. Same P/Vમાં Q ઘટવાથી current ઘટે; bank losses રહે, kvar rating એટલે kWh saving નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Fixed/switched, LV/HV/star-delta જુદી axes; units, fuses/protection, switch, discharge resistors/ક્યારેક reactor installation બને.
  • Staged control light-load overcompensation અટકાવે; resonance, inrush, unbalance/overvoltage study જોઈએ.Isolation પછી charge રહે.
  • Maintenanceમાં bulge/leak, fuse, unbalance, joint, reactor/discharge path; specified wait, verify discharge/earth પછી touch.

h.gu: PF Correction તથા Star/Delta Capacitance Derivation

body.en:
Definition

Power-factor correction adjusts the reactive-power balance so that the ratio of real to apparent power approaches a chosen target without unsafe leading operation.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Assume balanced sinusoidal 3-phase load, constant real power and bus voltage; distortion PF requires harmonic assessment beyond this displacement-PF triangle.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Since P=S cosφand Q=S sinφ, Q=P tanφ.Target compensation Qc=P(tanφ1−tanφ2).
  2. For total three-phase Qc=3ωCphaseVphase².In star, Vphase=VL/√3, so Cstar=Qc/(ωVL²)per phase.
  3. In delta, Vphase=VL, so Cdelta=Qc/(3ωVL²)per branch. Use var, V, Hz and Fconsistently.

Worked example / interpretation

  1. For 100 kW, 0.8to 0.95lag, tanφ1=0.75, tanφ2≈0.32868; Qc≈42.13 kvar.
  2. At 415 V, 50 Hz, Cstar≈778.7µFper phase; Cdelta≈259.6µFper branch. These are ideal computations, not procurement selections.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

PF correction reactive balance સુધારે જેથી real/apparent power ratio targetની નજીક આવે, unsafe leading operation વિના.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Balanced sinusoidal 3-phase, constant P/V ધારો; distortion PFમાં આ triangle ઉપરાંત harmonics assessment જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. P=S cosφ/Q=S sinφથી Q=P tanφ; Qc=P(tanφ1−tanφ2).
  2. Qc=3ωCphaseVphase²; starમાં Vphase=VL/√3થી Cstar=Qc/(ωVL²)per phase.
  3. Deltaમાં Vphase=VLથી Cdelta=Qc/(3ωVL²)per branch; var, V, Hz/F consistent લો.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / અર્થઘટન

  1. 100 kW, 0.8થી0.95lagમાં tanφ1=0.75/tanφ2≈0.32868; Qc≈42.13 kvar.
  2. 415 V/50Hzમાં Cstar≈778.7µFper phase/Cdelta≈259.6µFper branch; ideal ગણતરી, procurement selection નહીં.

h.en: OUCB: optimal utilisation and commercial case
h.gu: OUCB: Optimal Utilisation તથા Commercial Case

body.en:
Definition

Optimal utilisation of capacitor banks means selecting and operating suitable stages so the required reactive support is supplied at the right time without violating equipment, voltage or harmonic limits.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Build a time-based P/Q/Vprofile, identify target PF and tariff constraints, then evaluate stage sizes, control deadband, minimum off time and detuning/protection.
  • At 100 kW, a change from PF 0.8to 0.95reduces apparent demand from 125kVAto 105.26kVA, freeing 19.74kVAof capacity before practical limits.
  • At fixed P/V, current ratio=0.8/0.95≈0.8421; upstream copper-loss ratio≈0.7091if resistance is unchanged. Other station losses are not reduced by this ratio.
  • Illustrative demand tariff₹300/kVA-month on fully coincident billed demand gives gross₹5921/month for 19.74kVAreduction; actual savings need the actual tariff, interval profile, capital, loss and maintenance costs.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

OUCB યોગ્ય stages/timeથી જરૂરી reactive support આપે અને equipment, voltage/harmonic limits નતોડે તેવી bank utilisation છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Time-based P/Q/V profileથી target PF/tariff જાણી stage sizes, deadband, min off time/detuning-protection assess કરો.
  • 100kWમાં PF 0.8થી0.95થી125kVA→105.26kVA, difference 19.74kVA capacity, before practical limits.
  • Fixed P/Vમાં current ratio=0.8/0.95≈0.8421/copper-loss ratio≈0.7091if R same; બીજા station losses આ ratioથી ઘટતા નથી.
  • Illustrative₹300/kVA-monthમાં19.74kVAથી gross₹5921/month; actual saving માટે tariff, profile, capital/loss/maintenance જોઈએ.

title.en: 3.5 PPE, LOTO, permit and rescue boundaries
title.gu: 3.5 PPE, LOTO, Permit તથા Rescue Boundaries

h.en: PPE, LOTO, permit and rescue boundaries
h.gu: PPE, LOTO, Permit તથા Rescue Boundaries

body.en:
Definition

LOTOis a controlled process of identifying, isolating, securing and verifying hazardous energy sources so they cannot unexpectedly energise equipment during authorised work.

Working / functional sequence

  1. For a classroom mock, use only isolated current-limited 24VDC: identify sources, announce/isolate, apply personal locks/tags under trainer control.
  2. Verify the tester on a known source, test the isolated points, then re-prove the tester as applicable; follow the approved test-before-touch process.
  3. Control stored energy and access; complete work/inspection, account for persons/tools, and release locks/restore only through the authorised process.

Detailed explanation and application

  • IS 5216Part 1covers general electrical safety guidance; Part 2concerns life-saving techniques. Use current certified CPR/AEDtraining, not obsolete historical respiration methods.
  • PPEis selected by task, voltage/arc assessment and certification; source 600VDMM, 1kVgloves or 220Vtraining kits do not permit student HVwork.
  • Apermit specifies apparatus, limits, isolation/earthing, persons and return conditions; backfeed, stored capacitor energy, induction and auxiliary DCmust be considered.
  • In an electrical emergency do not touch an energised casualty: raise alarm, obtain safe isolation and emergency help; trained responders apply current CPR/AEDwithin competence.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

LOTO hazardous sources identify/isolate/secure/verify કરીને authorised work દરમિયાન unexpected energisation અટકાવવાની controlled process છે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Mockમાં માત્ર isolated current-limited 24VDC: sources identify, announce/isolate, trainer હેઠળ personal locks/tags.
  2. Tester known source પર prove, isolated points test/પછી re-prove; approved test-before-touch અનુસરો.
  3. Stored energy/access control; inspection/persons/tools count; authorised processથી જ locks release/restore.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

"""Offline educational state models only; no network, device I/O, relay settings or VLab claim."""
from math import sqrt

def recloser(permanent=True,sectionaliser=True,max_trips=3,count_limit=2):
    if max_trips<1 or not 1<=count_limit<max_trips:raise ValueError('Need a restoration attempt after sectionaliser count')
    events=[];fault=True;isolated=False
    for n in range(1,max_trips+1):
        events.append({'event':'TRIP','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not permanent:fault=False
        if sectionaliser and fault and n==count_limit:
            isolated=True;fault=False
            events.append({'event':'SECTIONALISER_OPEN','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':True})
        if n==max_trips:
            events.append({'event':'LOCKOUT','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated});break
        events.append({'event':'DEAD_TIME','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        events.append({'event':'RECLOSE','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not fault:
            events.append({'event':'HEALTHY_RESTORED','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated});break
    return events

def permit(role=True,quality='GOOD',age=0,cb='OPEN',earth='OPEN',code='01',command='CLOSE'):
    # Declared DOUBLE-POINT MODEL mapping only: 00 intermediate, 01 open, 10 closed, 11 bad.
    reasons=[]
    if not role:reasons.append('NO_AUTHORITY')
    if quality!='GOOD' or age<0 or age>2:reasons.append('BAD_OR_STALE')
    if code not in ('01','10'):reasons.append('INVALID_POSITION')
    if cb!='OPEN':reasons.append('CURRENT_NOT_REMOVED')
    if earth!='OPEN':reasons.append('EARTH_NOT_CONFIRMED_OPEN')
    if command not in ('OPEN','CLOSE'):reasons.append('BAD_COMMAND')
    if (command,code)in(('CLOSE','10'),('OPEN','01')):reasons.append('ALREADY_IN_POSITION')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'reasons':reasons,'status_map':{'00':'INTERMEDIATE','01':'OPEN','10':'CLOSED','11':'BAD'}}

def transfer(load_a,load_b,capacity_b,compatible=True,fault=False):
    if min(load_a,load_b)<0 or capacity_b<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid MVA')
    reasons=[]
    if not compatible:reasons.append('INCOMPATIBLE_SOURCES')
    if fault:reasons.append('FAULT_OR_PROTECTION_BLOCK')
    if load_a+load_b>capacity_b:reasons.append('OVERLOAD')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'combined_MVA':load_a+load_b,'reasons':reasons,
            'policy':'Open-transition classroom capacity screen only; actual transfer needs approved order, voltage/phase/protection checks, no unapproved paralleling.'}

def oltc(vin=11000,target=11000,ratio=1.0,step=0.0125,deadband=100,delay=3,elapsed=3,tap=0,min_tap=-8,max_tap=8):
    # Model vout=vin*(ratio + tap*step). Positive tap increases this controlled output ratio.
    if vin<=0 or target<=0 or ratio<=0 or step<=0 or deadband<0 or delay<0 or elapsed<0 or not min_tap<=tap<=max_tap:raise ValueError('Invalid model inputs')
    before=vin*(ratio+tap*step);action='HOLD';aftertap=tap
    if abs(before-target)>deadband and elapsed>=delay:
        wanted=tap+(1 if before<target else -1)
        if min_tap<=wanted<=max_tap:aftertap=wanted;action='STEP'
        else:action='LIMIT'
    elif abs(before-target)>deadband:action='WAIT'
    return {'before':before,'tap':aftertap,'after':vin*(ratio+aftertap*step),'action':action}

def plc(start=False,stop_ok=True,estop_ok=True,overload_ok=True,guard_ok=True,latched=False):
    # No safety certification. Real emergency-stop circuit must be appropriately independent/hardwired.
    q=bool(stop_ok and estop_ok and overload_ok and guard_ok and (start or latched))
    return {'motor':q,'run_latch':q,'alarm':not(overload_ok and guard_ok and estop_ok)}

def fault_zone(zone):
    routes={'FEEDER':{'trips':['FEEDER_CB'],'healthy_bus':True},'TRANSFORMER':{'trips':['HV_CB','LV_CB'],'healthy_bus':False},'BUS':{'trips':['ALL_ZONE_BOUNDARIES'],'healthy_bus':False}}
    if zone not in routes:raise ValueError('Unknown zone')
    return routes[zone]
